{"code": "import requests, json, datetime, difflib, re\\n\\ndef fetch_revisions(page, start_ts, direction='older', limit=500):\\n    S = requests.Session()\\n    URL = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php'\\n    params = {\\n        'action': 'query',\\n        'format': 'json',\\n        'prop': 'revisions',\\n        'titles': page,\\n        'rvstart': start_ts,\\n        'rvlimit': limit,\\n        'rvprop': 'ids|timestamp|comment|user|content',\\n        'rvdir': direction,\\n        'rvcontentformat': 'text',\\n        'rvcontentmodel': 'wikitext'\\n    }\\n    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (bot)'}\\n    resp = S.get(URL, params=params, headers=headers)\\n    data = resp.json()\\n    pages = data.get('query', {}).get('pages', {})\\n    revs = []\\n    for pid, pinfo in pages.items():\\n        revs.extend(pinfo.get('revisions', []))\\n    return revs\\n\\n# get revisions around 2004-02-29 both older and newer\\ncenter = '2004-02-29T12:00:00Z'\\nolder = fetch_revisions('Dragon', center, direction='older', limit=200)\\nnewer = fetch_revisions('Dragon', center, direction='newer', limit=200)\\nprint('older', len(older), 'newer', len(newer))\\n# combine and sort by timestamp\\nall_revs = older + newer\\n# sort by timestamp ascending\\nall_revs.sort(key=lambda r: r['timestamp'])\\nprint('total', len(all_revs))\\n# Show timestamps of first few\\nfor rev in all_revs[:10]:\\n    print(rev['timestamp'], rev.get('comment','')[:60])\\n"}

{"code": "import requests, json\\n\\ndef get_all_revisions(page, limit=5000):\\n    S = requests.Session()\\n    URL = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php'\\n    params = {\\n        'action': 'query',\\n        'format': 'json',\\n        'prop': 'revisions',\\n        'titles': page,\\n        'rvprop': 'ids|timestamp|comment|user|content',\\n        'rvlimit': limit,\\n        'rvdir': 'newer',\\n        'rvstart': '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z',\\n        'rvcontentformat': 'text',\\n        'rvcontentmodel': 'wikitext'\\n    }\\n    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (bot)'}\\n    resp = S.get(URL, params=params, headers=headers)\\n    data = resp.json()\\n    pages = data.get('query', {}).get('pages', {})\\n    revs = []\\n    for pid, pinfo in pages.items():\\n        revs.extend(pinfo.get('revisions', []))\\n    return revs\\n\\nrevs = get_all_revisions('Dragon', limit=500)\\nprint('found', len(revs))\\nif revs:\\n    print('first', revs[0]['timestamp'], revs[0].get('comment',''))\\n    print('last', revs[-1]['timestamp'], revs[-1].get('comment',''))\\n"}

{"code": "import requests, json, time\\n\\ndef fetch_all_revisions_until(page, end_ts, batch=500):\\n    S = requests.Session()\\n    URL = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php'\\n    params = {\\n        'action': 'query',\\n        'format': 'json',\\n        'prop': 'revisions',\\n        'titles': page,\\n        'rvprop': 'ids|timestamp|comment|user|content',\\n        'rvlimit': batch,\\n        'rvdir': 'newer',\\n        'rvstart': '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z',\\n        'rvend': end_ts,\\n        'rvcontentformat': 'text',\\n        'rvcontentmodel': 'wikitext'\\n    }\\n    headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (bot)'}\\n    all_revs = []\\n    while True:\\n        resp = S.get(URL, params=params, headers=headers)\\n        data = resp.json()\\n        pages = data.get('query', {}).get('pages', {})\\n        for pid, pinfo in pages.items():\\n            revs = pinfo.get('revisions', [])\\n            all_revs.extend(revs)\\n        if 'continue' in data:\\n            cont = data['continue']\\n            params.update(cont)\\n            time.sleep(0.1)\\n        else:\\n            break\\n    return all_revs\\n\\nrevs = fetch_all_revisions_until('Dragon', '2008-02-29T23:59:59Z')\\nprint('total revs fetched', len(revs))\\n# filter comments containing joke\\njoke_revs = [r for r in revs if r.get('comment') and 'joke' in r['comment'].lower()]\\nprint('joke revs', len(joke_revs))\\nfor r in joke_revs[:10]:\\n    print(r['timestamp'], r['comment'])\\n"}
